description: This false-color satellite or aerial image displays an agricultural landscape dominated by "complex cultivation patterns" alongside a densely settled area and a river. Vigorous vegetation, indicative of actively growing "Diverse annual crops" or "permanent crops" such as vineyards, fruit trees, or berry plantations, appears bright red. Bare soil, harvested fields, or senescent vegetation are shown in shades of light blue and grey. These agricultural areas are characterized by small, irregularly shaped parcels, some appearing as long, narrow strips, which create a 'coarse texture' and 'mix of diverse colours'. A dense settlement occupies the central part of the image, featuring a visible grid-like pattern of roads or property boundaries, indicated by faint blue overlay lines, and numerous small buildings interspersed with green spaces, appearing in brownish-green to grey tones. A dark blue/grey linear feature, likely a river or stream, flows along the left side of the image, winding through the agricultural areas.
